verdict.rationale: Pandoc ships a Haskell library and an HTTP server mode, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The online and WebAssembly demos are conversion playgrounds, an adjacent feature rather than an explorable API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
